# clusterer.mjs

[Source](https://github.com/uol-library/spacefinder/blob/develop/assets/js/modules/clusterer.mjs)

Minimal marker clustering for Leaflet 2.0.

Leaflet.markercluster has no Leaflet 2.0-compatible release (it still
depends on the global L and factory methods removed in 2.0), so this is a
small grid-based clusterer covering just what Spacefinder needs: grouping
markers into clusters at low zoom levels, expanding to individual markers
at spacefinder.markergroup's `disableClusteringAtZoom`, zooming to a
cluster's bounds on click, and zooming a specific marker into view.
Spiderfying and cluster-boundary polygons are intentionally not
implemented - Spacefinder doesn't use them (spiderfyOnMaxZoom is off).

**Exports:** `SimpleMarkerClusterGroup`

<a name="SimpleMarkerClusterGroup"></a>

## SimpleMarkerClusterGroup
A layer group which shows its markers in clusters at low zoom levels

<a name="new_SimpleMarkerClusterGroup_new"></a>

### new SimpleMarkerClusterGroup(options)

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| options | <code>Object</code> |  |
| options.maxClusterRadius | <code>number</code> | size of the grid used for clusters, in pixels (default 80) |
| options.disableClusteringAtZoom | <code>number</code> | zoom level at which markers are no longer clustered (default 18) |
| options.zoomToBoundsOnClick | <code>boolean</code> | whether clicking a cluster zooms to its markers (default true) |

<a name="SimpleMarkerClusterGroup+zoomToShowLayer"></a>

### simpleMarkerClusterGroup.zoomToShowLayer(marker, callback)
Zooms/pans until the given marker is shown individually (not part of
a cluster), then calls the callback.

**Kind**: instance method of [<code>SimpleMarkerClusterGroup</code>](#SimpleMarkerClusterGroup)  

| Param | Type |
| --- | --- |
| marker | <code>Marker</code> | 
| callback | <code>function</code> | 

<a name="SimpleMarkerClusterGroup+_clusterAtZoom"></a>

### simpleMarkerClusterGroup.\_clusterAtZoom(zoom) ⇒ <code>Array</code>
Groups the current markers into clusters as they would appear at a
given zoom level, without changing the map's view.

**Kind**: instance method of [<code>SimpleMarkerClusterGroup</code>](#SimpleMarkerClusterGroup)  
**Returns**: <code>Array</code> - array of { latlng, markers } cluster descriptors  

| Param | Type |
| --- | --- |
| zoom | <code>Number</code> | 

<a name="SimpleMarkerClusterGroup+_recluster"></a>

### simpleMarkerClusterGroup.\_recluster()
Rebuilds the rendered layer to match the current clustering, but only
touches layers that actually need to change. Removing and re-adding a
marker that already has an open popup would close that popup (Leaflet
closes a marker's bound popup whenever the marker is removed from the
map), so unchanged individual markers are left exactly as they are.

**Kind**: instance method of [<code>SimpleMarkerClusterGroup</code>](#SimpleMarkerClusterGroup)
